correctness.rationale: For characteristic at least 5, the first/cubic-sum equations reduce to (x+y)(x-s)(y-s)=c. Parameters c=0 and c=8s³/27 have explicit triples. Otherwise its projective closure has exactly 3 nonsingular points at infinity; singularity differentiation shows no affine singularity. Genus one and Hasse yield >3 F_q-points for q>=11, hence an affine solution. Exact F5/F7 enumerations plus scaling give missing sets and a cardinality argument proves 4C full; Frobenius additivity treats char 3; first-coordinate-zero obstruction proves 2C proper. Independent finite-field arithmetic confirms the listed small cases and twelve tests but is not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Determines the precise additive diameter of a classical natural polynomial graph in every odd finite field: non-basis in characteristic 3, sharp orders four at 5 and 7, and three uniformly for all q>=11 with p>=5. Identifies the exact deficient target classes at both exceptional field sizes, using a meaningful genus-one covering mechanism rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
